development.typeError: New concrete factory methods exposed an existing independent journal implementation. Keep established three-method base port truthful; receipt extension stays separate until adapter hardening. No journal source or guard changed.

guardReview.retention: For old single slots, entry.slots=[slot], so any missing slot is exactly the original !slots.has(slot) rule. Receipt proof drops if any actual entry address is absent.
guardReview.address: Disjoint canonical single/receipt tuples; complete ordered actual indices copied before await; existing8position bound, no global page registry
guardReview.basePort: Exactly old clear/retain/check contract. New receipt extension is separate; journal adapter not asserted to implement it.
guardReview.meter: Counts each retained ArrayBuffer backing capacity once, including separately owned inputs and value; no RAM claim or new cache trust/limit.

newRequired.dynamicCaseCensus: Required at execution; static declarations are not a case denominator.

limitations: No receipt consumer uses checkReceipt yet; all semantic readers and the independently implemented authenticated preparation journal remain to harden.
Portable base interface remains exactly clear/retain/check; it is not falsely asserted to have the new extension.
ownedBytes measures retained backing-buffer capacity, not strings/object/VM overhead, RAM, or performance.
No change to verifiedRecords, prefix comparison, native authority, durable/wire format, budgets/limits or default.
No native binary cold, writer/G8/B/old artifacts/rollback images or Stage5 credit.
